hud.peterwolfs_apollo11.flight.title: APOLLO 11 / TRANSLUNAR INSERTION
command.peterwolfs_apollo11.launch.requi: Hold an Apollo rocket in your main hand.
command.peterwolfs_apollo11.landing.usag: Use /apollo landing burn during translunar flight to apply a manual retrograde burn.
landing.peterwolfs_apollo11.approach.mid: Guidance is active. Optional input: /apollo landing burn; autopilot will assist.
landing.peterwolfs_apollo11.approach.pro: Manual descent is active. Apply /apollo landing burn before touchdown.
landing.peterwolfs_apollo11.burn.autopil: The EASY autopilot is handling this burn.
landing.peterwolfs_apollo11.result.assis: Guidance computer corrected the descent; assisted landing complete.
Guided manual burn confirmed; assisted landing complete.
landing.peterwolfs_apollo11.result.manua: Manual retrograde burn verified; touchdown complete.
landing.peterwolfs_apollo11.abort: Professional landing failed: no retrograde burn. Emergency abort returned you to the launch site.
